content.text:
No, it hasn't been migrated. `src/services/user-service.js` still uses the old callback style. It imports `query` and `update` straight from `../db.js`, and a comment at `src/services/user-service.js:3` says the switch to `UserRepository` is still to come ("Chapter 5").

`UserRepository` is already written in `src/repositories/user-repository.js`, and its promise-based methods match the service's functions one for one:

| user-service.js (callback) | UserRepository (promise) |
|---|---|
| `listActiveUsers(cb)` | `findActive()` |
| `findUser(id, cb)` | `findById(id)` |
| `softDeleteUser(id, when, cb)` | `softDelete(id, when)` |

The project's `migrate-module` skill converts one service file to its repository and runs that module's tests, so it can do this migration. Switching to promises will break callers that pass callbacks, such as `src/api/routes.js` and `tests/user-service.test.js`, unless they're updated too. I can run the migration if you want.
